Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of 1.5Pt1.5Ru/C catalysts (Fig. 1a and 1b) exhibit diffraction peaks positioned at 2θ values of 39.7°, 46.2°, 67.4°, and 81.3°, which are indicative of the (1 1 1), (2 0 0), (2 2 0), and (3 1 1) planes of the fcc crystalline structure of metallic pure bulk Pt. These peaks are compared with the reference pattern (ICDD-JCPDS Card No. 040802).
